Resident Manager Job at Collection Development Limited




        
    

        
        Collection Development Limited - We develop, manage, and invest with the purpose of improving property and places to deliver lasting commercial and social benefit. We are a curious team of real estate experts who identify opportunities where we can create and capture significant value. We are Collection Developments.

Our goal is to create places that people want to be in. We take a long-term approach to real estate, maximising risk-adjusted returns across portfolios and generating consistent returns for our partners whilst setting new standards for homes, workplaces and cultural spaces that people love.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Resident Manager
     

            
    



Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Acting as Resident Warden and community-builder in a male student hostel.
	Overseeing the health, safety, hygiene, and general welfare of the residency.
	Ensuring student adherence to rules and maintaining decorum.
	Supervising facility operations, upgrades, and furniture/fittings management.
	Managing personnel and ensuring ancillary activities comply with standards.
	Handling misconduct, disciplinary issues, and emergency health matters.
	Performing administrative duties such as reporting, documentation, tenancy processing, inspections, and safety checks.
	Representing management in meetings, handling breaches of agreement, and overseeing lettings and tenancy agreements.
	Ensuring electrical/mechanical systems are maintained and inspected.
	Building and nurturing a professional, supportive, and accountable environment for students and vendors alike.
	This role requires a blend of approachability, authority, confidentiality, and effective communication, along with the ability to manage teams, understand health and safety standards, and possess strong administrative and computer skills.


Requirements


	HND or B.Sc. Degree in Estate Management, Facility Management, Property Management, Hospitality Management, Business Administration or a related discipline.
	Minimum 5 years of relevant experience, preferably managing a large residential facility, student hostel, estate, university accommodation or similar property.
	Proven experience in facility maintenance, vendor/contractor management, resident/customer management and staff supervision.


Attributes:


	The role of Warden is a challenging position and requires a fine balance between enforcing discipline and supporting and bonding with students and vendors.
	Wardens must be approachable and available to all students.
	Wardens must be able to respect confidentiality. Be empathetic and patient.
	Wardens must be proactive and take personal responsibility, have the ability to go beyond the call of duty.
	They should have a basic knowledge of health and safety practices and be open to learning new skills.
	Ability to work in a team, motivate, supervise and develop vendors to deliver target outcomes.
	Very good communication skills.
	Basic computer skills with working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.
	Good writing skills to capture data, manage budgets, collect feedback, design reports and conduct surveys.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.
